card.name: Slot just before the word people
card.fires_on: Words that come right before an expected "people" or "the population", such as "of" after billions or proportion, or "million" after a number. It appears in general web text about populations, poverty, water, and governments.

modes.label: Share of a population
modes.description: "of" after proportion or livelihoods, before "the population".

modes.label: Government over citizens
modes.description: "which" after "a government in", where citizens or people come next.

card.writes: It raises "people" in English and Chinese and lowers words for players, athletes and students.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "people" is expected, as in "billions of" or "40 million".
